Please confirm the amount against PO-LEARINGNA2 and the supporting documents, and decide whether it needs manual approval at the higher value.","email_subject": "Request for Confirmation of Invoice 2026/4896","email_body": "Dear Etosha Gate Border Services team,

Thank you for invoice 2026/4896 dated 2026-05-20, referencing PO-LEARINGNA2, for a total of 20043.35 NAD.

The invoice is currently on hold in our accounts payable review because the total exceeds our automatic approval limit. To help us process it, could you please confirm the invoice total and send a corrected or itemized invoice if any figures need adjusting?

We appreciate your cooperation. Please note that this message does not confirm approval or a payment date.

Kind regards,
Accounts Payable"}
